identity.title: An Updated 2017 Astrometric Solution for Betelgeuse

paper_type_evidence.quote: combined with existing VLA and new e-MERLIN and ALMA positions.

question.value: Does the revised 2007 Hipparcos intermediate astrometric data, combined with VLA, e-MERLIN and ALMA radio positions, change Betelgeuse's parallax and distance?

evidence.quote: we have been asked whether the revised (cite: 2007ASSL..350.....V) intermediate astrometric data would lead to a different VLA+*Hipparcos*  combined solution.
(Project code: 2015.1.00206.S , PI: P. Kervella)
Both sets of observations were carried out in Band 7 with identical spectral setups
a single continuum data set centered at $\simeq$338 GHz with a $\sim$5.9 GHz bandwidth was used
The maximum baseline in the long baseline observation was 16 km
which yielded an angular resolution of $\sim$15 mas
on 2015 November 9 and again on 2016 August 16 in a more compact configuration
(Project code: 2015.1.00206.S , PI: P. Kervella)

provided.value: radio positions from Harper et al. 2008

evidence.quote: combined with the full radio positional data in Table [1](#tab:positions) and (cite: 2008AJ....135.1430H).
three e-MERLIN observations obtained at 5.75  GHz (5.2 cm)
The HIAD were retrieved from the DVD included in (cite: 2007ASSL..350.....V)
There are 66 scan level abscissa $(a)$ measurements
combined with the full radio positional data in Table [1](#tab:positions) and (cite: 2008AJ....135.1430H).
The flux scale is accurate to $\sim$10%.

task.value: positions fitted in uv-plane with uvmultifit (uniform elliptical disk) on un-self-calibrated continuum

evidence.quote: the source position was extracted from the un-self-calibrated continuum datasets using the Python-based task uvmultifit
the channels containing line emission were excluded from the analysis
will be described in more detail in a future publication (P. Kervella, et al. 2017, in preparation)

method.value: Half of 5 mas axis extension taken as radio noise, added in quadrature

evidence.loc: 2.3 Sources of Additional Radio Positional Noise
evidence.quote: We adopt approximately half this value as the nominal radio noise, i.e. $\sigma_{radio}^{noise}=2.4$ mas.

validation.value: Eight alternative ALMA fits give centroid scatter of 0.43 mas

evidence.loc: 2.3 Sources of Additional Radio Positional Noise

method.value: Minimize chi2 of HIAD abscissa residuals plus radio position offsets

evidence.quote: We used Levenberg-Marquardt least-squares minimization (cite: 2009ASPC..411..251M) with the 65 1D HIAD scans and each of the 18 2D radio position.
We compute the parallaxes using the JPL DE405 IRCF ephemerides
for a total of 101 individual evaluations

using the Python-based task uvmultifit
We used Levenberg-Marquardt least-squares minimization (cite: 2009ASPC..411..251M)
we find a parallax of $\pi=5.27\pm 0.78$ mas
standard deviation of 0.43 mas

findings_qualitative.value: Radio proper motions differ from Hipparcos, giving smaller parallax and greater distance

evidence.quote: leads to a smaller parallax (greater distance) than either *Hipparcos*  solution

claims.hypothesis: Revised HIAD with radio positions changes Betelgeuse's parallax
claims.experiment: Combined fit of 2007 HIAD with VLA, e-MERLIN, ALMA positions with 2.4 mas radio noise
claims.finding: Consistent with Harper 2008 (0.7 sigma), 2.6 sigma from van Leeuwen

evidence.quote: only $0.7\sigma$ different from the 2008 solution of Harper et al. it is $2.6\sigma$ different from the solution of van Leeuwen

limitations_admitted.value: Radio noise value is approximate; ALMA compact-configuration uncertainty may be underestimated

evidence.quote: This in turn might lead to an underestimation of the uncertainty reported in Table [2](#tab:propermotion_alt).

referee_caveats_inferred: Radio cosmic noise of 2.4 mas is heuristic and drives the parallax
Photo-center motions are correlated, violating the random-noise assumption
Only two ALMA epochs, one at modest quality

missing_for_reproduction: Full radio position table incl. VLA
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: ~100 GB for two ALMA Band 7 long and compact datasets
reproducibility.score_reason: Astrometric fit is clear, but ALMA processing and the radio-noise choice are thinly documented.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: ALMA role is minor and the processing recipe is incomplete.
